name: QR Studio
desc: A QR code builder that runs in the browser. Styles, colors, logos and exports are all handled on your device, with no account and no backend.

p: QR Studio makes QR codes for URLs, plain text, Wi-Fi networks, email, phone numbers and SMS. You pick a shape for the modules and the corner markers, set solid or gradient colors, add a logo, and download the result as PNG, SVG or JPEG.
The preview redraws as you change a setting. It also tracks how much data fits at the chosen error-correction level and warns before the code gets too dense.

QR content and uploaded logos never leave the page. A recent commit removed Google Analytics and the hosted feedback form, and the Inter font is now bundled with the app, so normal use makes no third-party requests.
It's plain JavaScript on Vite, with the qr-code-styling library doing the drawing. Browser tests run in Playwright. Offline install as a PWA is on the roadmap in the README but isn't built yet.
